title: Changelog — vd3
opening: Release notes for the vd3 line packages — @vanduo-oss/vd3 (the Vue 3 design system and component library), @vanduo-oss/vd3-charts, and @vanduo-oss/vd3-flowchart.

title: vd3
opening: Everything below ships in one package and answers to one set of tokens. Open a card for the detail.

title: Theme customizer — Theme — vd3
opening: VdThemeCustomizer lets users personalize the theme in real time — palette, primary color, neutral scale, border radius, and font family — all on top of the default Open Color palette. Every control writes through the shared useThemePreference() singleton, so it stays in sync with the Theme Switcher and persists to localStorage. Color mode itself lives in the switcher; see the Theme Customizer walkthrough for the full story. Two presentations ship: variant="panel" (the default editor below) and variant="swatches", a primary-only fan for dock and toolbar chrome.

title: vd3 Architecture — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 is a single, standalone Vue 3 package. Everything is generated in one direction — design tokens → generated color CSS → absorbed component CSS → typed components & composables — so the styling and the behaviour always agree on the same --vd-* tokens and vd-* classes. There is no separate runtime to boot: the components are the runtime.

title: Oola Dock — Layout — vd3
opening: VdDock is a fat Seemore glass pill that morphs horizontal ↔ vertical through a square waypoint. Package defaults stay placement="bottom", no tint, radius 1.25, glass 34. This playground starts at bottom / theme ink (light black, dark green) / radius 1.5 / glass 34 / ū / stack. Brand click here cycles bottom → left → top → right → bottom. The package still morphs the paired edge (bottom ↔ left, top ↔ right). Fixed docks force a horizontal edge when the viewport is ≤520px; this playground opts out of that JS lock so Place and ū work in a narrow pane, and shows only the brand, centered. The #brand slot sits on the morph-origin corner — these demos use the oola ū mark. Replace it with your logo. Radius is dock-own and goes past the theme 0.5rem cap.

title: CBUN — vd3
opening: Charts and flowchart stay on the vd3 line — @vanduo-oss/vd3-charts and @vanduo-oss/vd3-flowchart — with full docs on this site. Draw, hex-grid, music-player, and code-editor live in @vanduo-oss/vdl-cbun; screenshots are here, full documentation is on labs.vanduo.dev.

title: Glass — Effects — vd3
opening: Seemore Glass is vd3’s frosted material system: every strength step follows the Fibonacci sequence so blur, tint, edge, and elevation move together — the same harmonic language as the rest of the kit. Opt in with .vd-glass and a step class; stage demos on package .vd-surface-* backdrops. Steps run through 89 (extreme marketing ceiling); prefer 1–21 for everyday UI.

title: Grid system — Foundation — vd3
opening: A comprehensive 12-column flexbox grid with Fibonacci/Golden Ratio proportional layouts, responsive containers, order utilities, and an interactive toggle between standard and Fibonacci modes.

title: Charts — Canvas — vd3
opening: vd3 Charts is the SVG-first data visualization widget from @vanduo-oss/vd3-charts. It features full WAI-ARIA Graphics Module 1.0 semantics, roving keyboard arrow navigation with live focus rings, an auto-generated accessible HTML data table fallback (WCAG 1.1.1), and native dark/light theme integration.

title: Card — Core — vd3
opening: Cards group content with consistent padding, borders, and elevation. Combine variants with .vd-card-glow, .vd-card-glass, or the Water Morph effect for richer demos.

title: Sticky — Layout — vd3
opening: Pin elements inside the nearest scrollable container as the user scrolls. If no scrollable parent exists, the element falls back to the viewport.

title: Color palette — Foundation — vd3
opening: vd3's default palette is Open Color (MIT) — the friendly, battle-tested scale you already know. For a look that shares the same DNA as vd3's spacing, type, and grid, opt into the Fibonacci palette — a golden-angle generated system where hues rotate by the golden angle (~137.5°) and every shade sits on a golden-ratio lightness ramp — via the runtime data-palette switch.

title: Fibonacci scale — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3's spacing, type, and radius scales follow the Fibonacci sequence (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21…) instead of a linear 4/8px grid. Because each step is the sum of the two before it, sizes relate to one another the way they do in nature — rhythm that feels balanced without manual tuning. It's a design philosophy baked into the tokens themselves, not any one component.

title: Typography — Foundation — vd3
opening: A fluid, golden-ratio type system: ten size steps, φ-derived line-heights, a tracking scale, and five runtime-switchable font families — all driven by --vd-* tokens.

title: Doc Search — Core — vd3
opening: VdDocSearch is a combobox/listbox search over a collection of documents you supply. Feed it a DocSearchDoc[] and the useDocSearch composable ranks matches (title > category > keywords > content), debounces typing, highlights the matched terms, and wires full keyboard navigation plus a global ⌘K / CtrlK shortcut. The component is a thin, accessible shell — reach for the composable directly when you want to render results your own way.

title: Theme switcher — Theme — vd3
opening: VdThemeSwitcher is a lightweight control for toggling between light, dark, and system color modes. It drives the shared useThemePreference() singleton, so it stays in sync with VdThemeCustomizer and persists to localStorage. Render it as an icon menu (default) or a single cycling button.

title: Tabs — Interactive — vd3
opening: Organize content into switchable panes. Tabs support horizontal and vertical layouts, multiple visual styles (default underline, boxed, pills, bordered), size variants, and fade animations — all CSS-driven with optional JavaScript for pane switching.

title: Installation & Integration — Guides — vd3
opening: Reference for installing @vanduo-oss/vd3: plugin options, the optional canvas bundle, vite-ssg, and Nuxt. For a five-minute first page, start at Getting started. vd3 is Vue 3 only.

title: Primitives — Layout — vd3
opening: Primitives are unstyled, single-responsibility layout containers. They express an intent — vertical rhythm, a wrapping row, a centered column — instead of one CSS property, and sit between utilities and components: tokens → (utilities | primitives) → components. Every primitive consumes the same Fibonacci spacing tokens, so layouts stay in proportion. Configure each through its Vue props — pad, gap, max, min, ratio, threshold.

title: Navbar — Layout — vd3
opening: VdNavbar is a responsive top navigation bar with brand, default, and actions slots, a built-in mobile hamburger + slide-in menu, optional dropdowns, and scroll-aware glass/transparent framing. It emits open/close/toggle and exposes imperative open() / close() / toggle() controls.

title: Preloader — Feedback — vd3
opening: Patterns for showing progress during navigation, lazy-loaded sections, and async work. Spinner markup, modifiers, quad loader (.vd-dynamic-loader*), accessibility notes, and the full CSS class reference live on Spinners. Determinate bars (sizes, stripes, indeterminate, stacked fills, API) are documented under Progress.

title: Timeline — Core — vd3
opening: A vertical (or alternating) spine of dated entries. Markers, icons, and entry cards are independently styleable. Add .vd-timeline-animated for staggered scroll-reveal, or .vd-timeline-playback to drive reveals from buttons.

title: Icons — Foundation — vd3
opening: vd3 includes Phosphor Icons — a flexible icon family with 1,500+ icons in 6 weights. Icons are bundled locally with no external dependencies.

title: Icons — Foundation — vd3
opening: vd3 includes Phosphor Icons — a flexible icon family with 1,500+ icons in 6 weights. Icons are bundled locally with no external dependencies.

title: Button — Core — vd3
opening: Clickable actions in contextual color variants, three sizes, and outline, ink, ghost, ring, and icon looks, with built-in loading and disabled states. Filled primary and status chrome uses contrast-aware on-fill ink (--vd-text-on-primary / --vd-text-on-status): bright hues keep dark labels in light and dark.

title: Lazy loading — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 ships useLazyLoad, an IntersectionObserver composable that defers work until an element scrolls into view — either firing a callback (observe) or fetching-and-injecting a content section (loadSection). Pair it with the bundler tactics below — route-level code splitting, async components, and native lazy images — so you ship only what a route needs and reveal the rest on demand.

title: Parallax — Effects — vd3
opening: Depth-on-scroll. Layers inside a .vd-parallax container translate at different rates as the container moves through the viewport, creating a sense of depth. Movement is driven by JavaScript on a requestAnimationFrame-throttled scroll listener and is fully disabled when the visitor requests reduced motion.

title: Surfaces — Effects — vd3
opening: Surfaces are reusable backdrop fills for heroes, marketing bands, and Seemore Glass demos. Ship .vd-surface plus a variant — mesh, stripe, noise, aurora, dots, or grid — then tune Fibonacci intensity with .vd-surface-3|5|8. Docs demos add site-only .seemore-surface-motion (hatch crawl, concentric ripples, aurora drift, diagonal dots/grid) — not part of the kit yet.

title: Datepicker — Forms — vd3
opening: The datepicker attaches a calendar popup to any text input. Supports custom date formats, min/max date constraints, and month/year navigation — all driven by data attributes and wired with useDatepicker.

title: CSS variables & theming — Guides — vd3
opening: Every color, space, radius, and font in vd3 is a CSS custom property (--vd-*). Override them in your own stylesheet and the whole system updates — no recompile, no JavaScript. This token layer ships with @vanduo-oss/vd3.

title: Waypoint (Scrollspy) — Layout — vd3
opening: Highlights the navigation entry for the section currently in view as the user scrolls, driven by the useWaypoint composable.

title: Security — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 is presentation-layer code, but a few habits keep an app safe. The library is conservative about where it will fetch or render external content — copy the samples below as they are; a stricter CSP than this will blank the theme.

title: Navigation — Core — vd3
opening: Catalog of vd3's navigation primitives — breadcrumbs, pagination, navbar, sidenav, and sticky. Each component has its own dedicated page for full API + demos; this page is a quick-reference index.

title: vd3 ecosystem — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 is the Vue 3 design system from vanduo-oss, shipped as a small, standalone set of packages under the @vanduo-oss scope. There is no separate token / CSS / JS split to wire together — one component library, dedicated charts and flowchart packages, plus an optional canvas bundle, documented by this site.

title: vd3 ecosystem — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 is the Vue 3 design system from vanduo-oss, shipped as a small, standalone set of packages under the @vanduo-oss scope. There is no separate token / CSS / JS split to wire together — one component library, dedicated charts and flowchart packages, plus an optional canvas bundle, documented by this site.

title: Golden ratio — Foundation — vd3
opening: This framework uses the Fibonacci sequence and Golden Ratio (phi = 1.618) as its proportional foundation. Spacing, typography, component dimensions, and grid layouts all derive from these mathematical relationships.

title: Code snippet — Primitives — vd3
opening: VdCodeSnippet is a copyable source block with two modes. Pass :code and :language for a simple figure. Pass any tab prop (html, css, js, shell, vue, json) for collapsible multi-tab chrome — the same “View Code” control used throughout these docs via DocCodeSnippet. The component does not color tokens unless you pass highlight. These pages pass the cbun tokenizer (highlightCode).

title: Tooltip — Feedback — vd3
opening: Contextual hover overlays that display supplementary information. Tooltips support four directional placements (top, bottom, left, right), light/dark/glass variants, size tiers, and HTML content. All positioning and visibility are handled via data attributes and CSS — minimal JavaScript is required for initialization.

title: About — vd3
opening: What vd3 UI is, and the ideas behind it

title: Modal — Feedback — vd3
opening: VdModal renders an overlay dialog for confirmations, forms, and focused tasks. Drive it from a boolean with v-model:open, choose one of four size tiers (or glass for a frosted panel), and fill the body / #footer slots — the header title and close button are rendered for you. It teleports to <body>, traps Escape, and closes on a backdrop click unless you opt out.

title: Liquid Gradient — Effects — vd3
opening: Interactive liquid atmosphere rendered with vanilla WebGL (no Three.js). Colors follow vd3 primary, neutral, and background tokens and update live with light/dark theme changes. Move the pointer over the demo to ripple the surface.

title: Getting started — Guides — vd3
opening: A five-minute path to a vd3-styled page with Vue 3 — Vite, one CSS import, the VanduoVue plugin, and a named VdCard / VdButton. For plugin options, Nuxt, and the canvas bundle, use Installation & Integration.

title: Getting started — Guides — vd3
opening: A five-minute path to a vd3-styled page with Vue 3 — Vite, one CSS import, the VanduoVue plugin, and a named VdCard / VdButton. For plugin options, Nuxt, and the canvas bundle, use Installation & Integration.

title: Expanding Cards — Core — vd3
opening: A horizontal strip of panels that expand on click/focus — one stays wide while the others stay slim. Use ← → when a panel is focused. Great for featured galleries and showcases where you want one focal item at a time.

title: Floating Action Button — Core — vd3
opening: VdFab surfaces a primary action as a round, elevated button. Pick a variant, size, position, or the extended pill; add an actions slot to turn it into a self-managing speed-dial menu (it owns its own open state, Escape, and outside-click handling).

title: Draggable — Interactive — vd3
opening: Pointer-, touch-, and keyboard-friendly drag-and-drop. Make any element draggable, group items into a sortable list, or drop items into a zone — the framework fires bubbling draggable:start, draggable:drag, and draggable:end events.

title: Flowchart — Canvas — vd3
opening: vd3 Flowchart is an SVG flowchart editor from @vanduo-oss/vd3-flowchart. Drag from the palette, connect ports, edit text inline, auto-arrange layouts, and export/import JSON. The demo below loads a radial mind map with branches and sub-topics. The toolbar Arrange control is a single <select> with three layout modes — Tree, Radial, and Grid — and always shows the active mode (no placeholder row). Hit Full screen to work across the whole viewport (Esc to come back). The chrome themes with the active --vd-flowchart-* tokens and the site light / dark mode.

title: Your first layout — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3's layout system is plain CSS — a 12-column responsive grid inside a container, with mobile-first breakpoints. Compose a page with VdNavbar, vd-container-responsive, and VdFooter.

title: Spinner — Primitives — vd3
opening: Canonical reference for vd3 loading spinners: border spinner, dot bounce, growing pulse, sizes and color modifiers, plus the signature quad-grid loader (.vd-dynamic-loader*). Styles ship in framework/css/components/spinner.css, imported by the main vanduo.css bundle — copy HTML only; no extra layout CSS is required. For loading UX patterns (progress handoff, placeholders), see Preloader.

title: Shadows & glow — Foundation — vd3
opening: vd3 provides a comprehensive shadow system based on Fibonacci proportions, plus glow effects for interactive elements. Shadows create depth and visual hierarchy, while glow effects add emphasis on hover.

title: Utilities cheat sheet — Guides — vd3
opening: A quick reference to vd3 utility classes from helpers.css, typography.css, colors.css, and shadow.css. These are pure CSS and work the same in static HTML and Vue templates. Spacing, gaps, and radii follow the Fibonacci scale.

title: Global Search — Core — vd3
opening: VdGlobalSearch is a site-wide command palette: glass overlay, grouped results, and keyboard navigation. Pass a GlobalSearchAdapter — the component stays engine-agnostic (Fuse.js, REST, or in-memory). These docs use Fuse over search-index.json (no semantic model).

title: Form controls — Forms — vd3
opening: The Vue 3 <VdInput> bundles the common field anatomy — label, helper text, validation message and affixes — into one component on the unified status-variant palette. type="number" binds a real number.

title: Progress — Primitives — vd3
opening: Linear progress bars with semantic color variants, multiple sizes, striped and animated styles, and indeterminate mode. Progress bars are fully CSS-driven — set the width via inline style or utility classes and the bar animates smoothly.

title: Pagination — Forms — vd3
opening: Page-by-page navigation for lists, tables, and search results. The VdPagination component renders a numbered control from a few data attributes, automatically collapsing long ranges with ellipses and emitting a pagination:change event as the user navigates.

title: Morph — Effects — vd3
opening: A liquid wave content-swap effect. Click triggers an expanding radial wave from the pointer position while the old content dissolves and the new content emerges. Works on any element.

title: Table — Data display — vd3
opening: Presentational VdTable (CSS table) plus VdDataTable — client search, sort, selection, and paging via useTableState. Apps own fetch. Cell slots compose VdAvatar / VdBadge; a dashboard recipe can sit a cbun VdChart above the grid.

title: Tree — Forms — vd3
opening: The VdTree component renders hierarchical data as an expandable/collapsible tree. Supports checkbox selection with parent-child cascade and initial open state — all driven by the :nodes prop plus the boolean checkbox / cascade props.

title: Button group — Forms — vd3
opening: Cluster related buttons so they share edges and read as a single control — horizontal or vertical, in three sizes, and optionally full-width.

title: Login — Forms — vd3
opening: Headless auth screens for Vue 3. They emit submit / social and never fetch — sessions, CSRF tokens, OAuth SDKs, and lockout copy stay in the app. Docs demos set :framed="false" so the cover shell does not steal the layout; apps use the default framed glass card.

title: Troubleshooting — Guides — vd3
opening: The most common issues when building with vd3, and the one-line fix for each. Most trace back to a missing CSS import, mixing the Vd* component model with class-markup composables, or touching the DOM during server rendering.

title: Accessibility — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3's components ship with sensible roles, labels, focus styles, and motion guards. Accessibility is mostly about not undoing those defaults as you compose — and filling the gaps only you can: meaningful labels, alt text, and logical structure.

title: Theme customizer — Guides — vd3
opening: vd3 themes by writing data-* attributes on <html> — the CSS reads them. In Vue 3 the useThemePreference() singleton sets those attributes, persists the choice to localStorage, and re-applies it on load.

title: Ripple — Core — vd3
opening: Material-style click ripples with zero JavaScript cost for the consumer. Drop vd-ripple on any element and the framework spawns a radial fill from the click point, animates it outward, and cleans up. Custom color and duration are first-class via attributes and CSS variables.

title: Skeleton — Feedback — vd3
opening: Loading placeholders that mimic the shape of content before it arrives. Skeletons use a shimmering animation by default and support text lines, headings, circles (avatars), rectangles (images), buttons, inputs, lists, and grids — all composable to match your actual layout.

title: Spotlight — Core — vd3
opening: Guide users through your interface with step-by-step tours. An overlay highlights target elements while a tooltip provides context and navigation controls. Add a JSON array of steps to any trigger via data-vd-spotlight and it starts on click.

title: Stepper — Forms — vd3
opening: Multi-step progress indicators for wizards, checkout flows, and onboarding sequences. Supports horizontal, vertical, and clickable variants with built-in state management, plus an optional staggered scroll-reveal (.vd-stepper-animated) that mirrors timeline.

title: Menu — Core — vd3
opening: VdMenu is a declarative dropdown menu: pass a label and an items array and it renders an accessible role="menu" popup, reusing the framework's dropdown runtime for toggle, keyboard and outside-click behaviour. To wire hand-written dropdown markup instead, call useDropdown(root).

title: Off-canvas — Layout — vd3
opening: Extend the Sidenav into a full offcanvas panel that slides in from any edge. Uses the existing useSidenav API with positional modifiers.

title: Production — Guides — vd3
opening: How to ship an app that consumes vd3: pin versions, import CSS once, keep JS named so it tree-shakes, and keep DOM work off the server. This is not a runbook for building these docs.

title: Flow — Interactive — vd3
opening: A carousel for stepping through a sequence of slides, with previous and next controls and optional looping.

title: Alert — Core — vd3
opening: Contextual feedback messages for typical user actions. Choose from semantic color variants, add dismissible close buttons, or combine icons with text for richer communication. Alerts are fully CSS-driven — no JavaScript required for static use.

title: Template — Core — vd3
opening: Common layout templates built from vd3 primitives. These are pure markup patterns — no JavaScript, no special build step. Copy and adapt them as starting points for your own pages.

title: Search — Interactive — vd3
opening: The framework ships a small registry for plugging named data sources into a search overlay. The package does NOT ship a UI — overlays (e.g. a global search modal) consume the registry. Sources can be local arrays, fetched JSON, or any async provider.

title: Breadcrumb — Data display — vd3
opening: VdBreadcrumb renders an accessible breadcrumb trail from an items array (or a custom default slot). It is markup-only — built on breadcrumbs.css — with the current page marked by aria-current="page" and no anchor.

title: Image Box — Media — vd3
opening: Click-to-zoom lightbox for images. Add data-image-box to any thumbnail and the framework opens a focus-trapped overlay showing data-image-box-full-src with an optional caption. Escape or a backdrop click closes it.

title: Accordion — Interactive — vd3
opening: Expandable content sections for FAQs, settings panels, and progressive disclosure. Use accordions to keep dense content scannable while revealing details on demand.

title: Transfer — Forms — vd3
opening: The VdTransfer component renders a dual-panel picker — users move items from a "Source" list to a "Target" list using arrow buttons. Search filtering is built into both panels automatically, and selected items are accessible programmatically at any time.

title: Autocomplete — Forms — vd3
opening: The suggest control adds type-ahead suggestions to any text input. Feed it a static JSON array or point it at a remote JSON endpoint — results filter as the user types, wired with useSuggest. Alias: data-vd-autocomplete.

title: Popover — Core — vd3
opening: Attribute-driven popover bubbles. Drop data-vd-bubble="…" on any element and the framework builds, positions, and wires the panel for you — with auto-placement flip on viewport overflow, outside-click and Escape dismissal. data-vd-popover is a drop-in alias.

title: Separator — Layout — vd3
opening: VdSeparator is a semantic divider with role="separator". Use it to break up stacked content, label a transition (e.g. "OR"), or split inline actions vertically. Pure CSS — no JavaScript.

title: Slider — Forms — vd3
opening: VdSlider styles a native <input type="range"> with a themed track, fill and thumb. It renders from pure CSS and binds with v-model (numbers) — with optional label and live value read-out.

title: Rating — Forms — vd3
opening: The VdRating component renders an interactive star-rating widget. Configure the maximum number of stars, pre-set a value, make it read-only, or pick a size variant — all through component props.

title: Switch — Forms — vd3
opening: VdSwitch is an accessible on/off toggle built on a native checkbox with role="switch". It needs no JavaScript — just the .vd-form-switch markup — and binds with v-model.

title: Toast — Feedback — vd3
opening: Brief, non-blocking notifications triggered imperatively with the useToast composable, in contextual success, error, warning, and info styles.

title: Badge — Core — vd3
opening: Small inline status indicators, counters, and labels. Badges scale with their parent font size and support contextual color variants, pill shapes, and three size tiers.

title: Form validation — Forms — vd3
opening: The useValidate composable provides declarative, attribute-driven form validation. Chain rules with pipe syntax (required|email|min:3), choose when validation triggers, and customise every error message — all without writing JavaScript.

title: Docs — vd3
opening: Explore vd3 Documentation, Guides and Changelog

title: Dropdown — Core — vd3
opening: Toggleable contextual overlays for displaying lists of links, actions, or custom content. Dropdowns support directional placement, glass styling, split buttons, and dark mode out of the box.

title: Timepicker — Forms — vd3
opening: The timepicker adds a scrollable time-selection dropdown to any text input. Choose between 12-hour and 24-hour formats, and configure the minute step interval. Wired with useTimepicker.

title: Avatar — Data display — vd3
opening: Represent a user or entity with an image, initials, or icon across a range of sizes and shapes, and combine several into a stacked group.

title: Footer — Layout — vd3
opening: VdFooter composes branded multi-column footers. Pass columns, dark, and size; drop your link sections into the default slot and legal text into the copyright slot.

title: Collection — Data display — vd3
opening: Vertical lists for grouped content such as menus, settings, and feeds, with optional icons, supporting text, and hoverable or linked items.

title: Sidenav — Layout — vd3
opening: Create overlay, push, or fixed side drawers with canonical vd-sidenav-* variants.

title: Chip — Feedback — vd3
opening: Compact tokens for tags, filters, and selections, with contextual colors, optional icons, and a removable (dismissible) variant.
